unit: exact sequence variant (not taxon, not denoised ASV, not OTU)

interpretation.hill_q1: Number of equally-common variants that would give the same Shannon entropy.
interpretation.chao1: Lower-bound estimate of true richness given the singleton/doubleton ratio.
interpretation.goods_coverage: Estimated fraction of the community represented by the sample.
interpretation.caveat: Richness is over exact sequence variants, not taxa. Sequencing error inflates it; it is an upper bound on organismal diversity.

rarefaction.interpretation: A curve still climbing steeply at full depth means the library is under-sampled: more sequencing would keep revealing new variants.
